steps.text: 1:35 P.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Landship, Cabin No. 3, Medical Bay

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ok, turn around.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Please try to hold still. Don't move your tail either.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: 61.3... Hmm, your tail has grown longer again.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Alright, that's all.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Is the checkup complete?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ahh, that tickled so bad! To be honest, I'm really not used to having my tail measured like this every time. It's really hard to keep it from moving.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Your reaction is still manageable, you tend to just twitch a little. The ones that are really hard to handle are those operators who suddenly try to attack you.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Yeah, there are some spots that are more sensitive after all. I've heard there are some races that you can't touch at all.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: It's true.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Ah, time's up. Here, breathe into this.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Huff——)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Done!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Yep, no issues.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: The results for the blood test will only be out the day after tomorrow, but I'll have the preliminary diagnostic report ready in a moment.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Here, please drink this dissolving agent.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'm so sorry for always taking up your time. I feel really bad that you have to do so many examinations.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I know my own body after all, there's really no problem...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Provence!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ehh, y-yes?

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Please don't say such things again. Just look at the examination data from this check-up, all the indicators have fluctuated!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You also stayed outside longer than planned this time!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Rhodes Island is currently deep in the wilderness and there are barely any known nomadic city routes nearby. Who knows how dangerous it is out there?!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: If we don't take proper precautions, it's extremely dangerous to stay in such a place!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: My bad, my bad. Please don't get angry at me, okay?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: There are a few small villages near our route, and I'm a little worried about them...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: You may be a professional Catastrophe Messenger, but you still have to look out for your own safety!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I promise! I guarantee I'll be safe!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Look, I covered myself up all the way, just like how you taught me. Don't worry, I won't take any chances with my health!

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Hmm...
Save your worries. The Catastrophe Messengers have their own ways of looking after themselves.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Especially for Messengers independent of any state, the lone wanderers of the wilderness...

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: I haven't seen many Catastrophe Messengers who could avoid getting infected, but a normal person would have died many times over if thrown into such environments.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: On the contrary, these Messengers are still as lively as ever.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Um, was that a compliment?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Sorry, what was that?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Well, you're not wrong. The environments we work in wouldn't be kind to the normal people. But, as long as you get the right training and avoid taking risks, it's actually not so bad.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: A lot of my colleagues work for a single city-state a big company. Keeps them away from the riskiest work and guarantees a nice salary.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Catastrophe Messengers get paid well, with a high bar to entry. The assessment tests are extremely tough.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: I see...

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Speaking of which, the two new operators who've just arrived recently seem to have been recommended here by the Catastrophe Messenger platform. Are they your peers as well, Provence?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ah, are you talking about Leonhardt and Tsukinogi?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Those two are very well-known, actually...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I met the both of them before coming for the check-up. I'm glad that Leonhardt seems to be adjusting well.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Oh? You know that long-eared brat?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: He worked this little one over so badly she burst into tears. Just ask her about it.

steps.name: Medic Operator
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin!

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Fine, fine. I've said enough.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ahahahahaha.

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Was it really that funny?

steps.name: Warfarin
steps.text: Oh, right. That brat and that heiress from Higashi haven't yet completed their check-ups. Since you know them, do help to call them over.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Haha, sure, no problem!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'll be going then~

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I'm done eating. Here's my plate, babe.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Skinny? What? Everyone my age is like this. I probably look a little skinner since I'm still growing.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Yup, I'm getting enough to eat. I'm always here eating your food, aren't I?

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: The fried rice cake today was delicious! And the egg rolls yesterday were really good too! Ah, I have to go. I have training next, so I'll see you later~

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: The people here are more vivacious than I expected.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: *Sigh* If I keep eating like this, I'll get fat sooner or later.
That doesn't sound too bad. The lady in the cafeteria seems to really like you.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Good afternoon, Leonhardt. Looks like you're doing well.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I figured you'd be at the cafeteria around this time, luckily you hadn't gone far. I was looking for you.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Good afternoon, Provence. Please don't make fun of me, I've really started to put on weight since I came here. Some of my clothes don't even fit anymore!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Why were you looking for me though?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Dr. Warfarin wants you for a follow-up examination. Not just you, Tsukinogi too.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I went to the dance room earlier, but there was no one there. I don't know where Tsukinogi might be...

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Ah, I know where she is.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Besides dancing her religious stuff, Tsukinogi also enjoys finding a quiet spot and looking at the scenery. I saw her near the outer layer just now, she might still be there.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ehh... You haven't been at Rhodes Island for long, but you already know so much.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hehe, I'm always paying attention to what people like, or don't like.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Follow me!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Accumulating clouds, a light breeze and dissipating fog...

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Looks like the weather is turning.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Ah, how lucky. Tsukinogi's still here.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Hello~ Tsukinogi.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Good afternoon, Tsukinogi!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Oh? Good afternoon, to the both of you.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: What's going on? Were you looking for me?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ah, yes. Dr. Warfarin told me to ask you to head to Medical, for a follow-up examination.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Is that so? Alright, I shall head over now.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Oh, it's not that urgent. I think the medics should be off for lunch now. If you take your time you'll still make it.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: That's right! The ladies of the Medical Department need their break. Let's take the chance to relax as well.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Have you had lunch yet, Tsukinogi? The cafeteria here is really good. I highly recommend the fried rice cakes and North Sadleir vegetable stew.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Hehe, I've already eaten.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: However, I will have to try out those dishes next time, since you recommended them so highly.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: They will definitely live up to your expectations!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hmm... The scenery here is really nice. I've never really paid attention to this spot before. Didn't expect there was such a place on the landship.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Tsukinogi is really amazing, the same Catastrophe Patrol of Higashi I've heard about.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: You flatter me. I was just looking for a quiet spot.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Dancing together with everyone is enjoyable, of course, but sitting here quietly and looking at the scenery is also quite pleasant.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: As Catastrophe Messengers ourselves, we also carry the duty of monitoring the environment while we are stationed on the landship. As such, this wouldn't be considered slacking off.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: How dedicated. I really have a lot to learn from my more experienced colleagues.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's our job after all. Ahh, I always end up unconsciously relaxing whenever I'm on the landship...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (What's going on? It feels like the weather's changed.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (Why would the tops of the clouds look like that...? They were fine when I came back this morning...)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (And the wind marks... The wind isn't blowing strongly, yet it's leaving such distinctive marks...)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Tsukinogi, look at the clouds over there...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This phenomenon, these traits, could it be...

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Blazing yet imperceptible. The fog has dispersed and a gale is building.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: I wasn't completely sure just now, however it seems that we are indeed unfortunate.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: The wind has changed——It's a Regional Catastrophe Outbreak!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I'll head out to check!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Watch out! A strong wind should be picking up soon, if you head out now you might get blown away!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Don't worry!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: ——Such a piddling breeze won't do anything to me!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Ahh... What an energetic young man.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: The darker clouds further beyond have started to spread. Based on the moisture in the air and the changing of the wind... Yes, I'm not wrong.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: These are the omens of an incoming Catastrophe.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: How unlucky. To think that we'd encounter a sudden Catastrophe like this.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: When Leonhardt gets back, we need to quickly inform Amiya and the people at the bridge! Thank goodness we discovered it early. We should still have enough time to change directions.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Luckily there aren't any nomadic cities that we need to inform around here.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Nomadic cities usually don't stay in regions with unstable weather like this.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: After all, if they encountered an emergency situation that escalated rapidly like this, the larger nomadic cities wouldn't be able to maneuver in time. The big shots in the cities would never take a risk like that.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: On the other hand, something like Rhodes Island would have no issues avoiding Catastrophes in such situations.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ehh, wait a minute... Oh no, oh no!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Around here... I remember there are a few villages in that direction!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Huh... Is that true? There are people living on such desolate land?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Of course it's true!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: There are quite a number of villages in the wilderness. It's the same in every country.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: They can't properly enter the nomadic cities, and the arable land around the cities is usually already claimed, so they have no choice but to settle somewhere further and live their lives taking one day at a time.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Since they don't really have a choice, everyone's always prepared to move at any time. All their belongings can be packed up quickly. There's not many people in each village, so they can usually escape to safety given some advance notice.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Oh, now that you mention it, I've heard of similar situations in Higashi.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Ah... Such things happen everywhere. Even so, no matter how much you get used to it, there is always a chance that you don't make it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: That's why I always try to make as many detours as possible, to warn these villages...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (I wonder if the villagers have noticed the changing weather.)

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: (If not...)

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Sorry to keep you waiting!

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: I had a look at it, and it doesn't bode well.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: The transformation of the cloud layer is happening very quickly, even the wind has changed. I don't expect this place to remain safe much longer, it'll be a few hours to half a day at most.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: That fast?!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: At that speed, the abnormal weather effects will occur all around us soon. We can't go outside like that anymore, it's too dangerous.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Don't worry, I know. I traveled a short distance towards the Catastrophe just now and didn't see any cities nearby.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: It'd have been dangerous if I continued forward even if I was adequately prepared, so we're unable to gather any more information for now.

steps.name: Leonhardt
steps.text: Ah, I'll tell you the rest later. Let me report to Amiya first.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Well then, we'll go and make our own preparations.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: No, I have to go to the villages! I won't be able to sleep at night if I don't!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Tsukinogi, I'll leave the preparations for the landship to you!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Hey, wait! Provence, I told you it's too dangerous!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Times like this, when we don't know how quickly the Catastrophe will form, even someone of your skill will be in great danger if you go too deep!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I... I will be very careful. Someone has to go and warn them!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: The large nomadic cities have their own Catastrophe Messengers, they'd be fine without us.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But these small villages and settlements are different!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: If we don't go, the people out there will probably get caught out.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: A sudden Catastrophe like this could easily catch them off guard long before they could get clear!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Even so...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Isn't our job to provide early warnings and do our best to mitigate the dangers brought about by the Catastrophes?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: They talk about Catastrophe Messengers like we get paid well and live nice, steady lives, but that's not me!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I've never forgotten my purpose.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: 'It's all about saving lives. More lives.'

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Maybe we all have our own ideas about that sentence.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But to me...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: To me, it means that whether it's the rich nobles living in the city, or the poor farmers living in the villages, all life is equally important. There is no distinction between lives.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Haha, alright. I understand you.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Equality of life does mean that one's life cannot be valued in terms of wealth or status...

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: That's a good philosophy.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Then...!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: However.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: What about your own life, Provence?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Huh? I...

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: To me, these equal lives also include yours.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Should I just let you put yourself in danger? Only to save more lives?

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Would you then weigh the value of lives in terms of numbers, and sacrifice the few to save the many?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...I wouldn't say so. If something can only be done by sacrificing lives, then there must be something intrinsically wrong with it.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But that has nothing to do with our situation! It's not the time to be discussing that either!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I know people have a Catastrophe bearing down on them, I have to go and warn them. It's my duty!

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: I won't stop you.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: After understanding your viewpoint, it'd be wrong of me to stop you.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: That's good——

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Yes, I won't stop you. I will go with you.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Oh, did you forget? I'm a Catastrophe Messenger too. It's only natural for me to go with you.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: But... It will really be dangerous...

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: I'm aware. That's why I have a request to make of you.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: If I determine that the situation is too dangerous, I will stop you even if I have to use force.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Is that acceptable?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: That...

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: I only hope that you can value your own life more.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I understand. We'll do that then. Let's go!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: How should I put this... You're very different from how I imagined.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I thought that an heiress from Higashi would be more... Umm, elitist and snobbish.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: Oh? That's a complete misunderstanding.

steps.name: Tsukinogi
steps.text: I've always been trying my best to grow closer to everyone at Rhodes Island. I've even started to reach saturation lately.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Saturation...? That sounds weird...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Whatever! Anyway, let's move! If we don't go now, we'll never make it in time!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: *Sigh* I'll definitely get chewed out by that girl in Medical again when I get back.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...Yeah, I'd better come up with my apology first.
